paragraphs: GameChanger sells a youth sports app that athletes, coaches, and families use to stay connected through live streaming, scorekeeping, team management, and developmental resources. The app is free for coaches on teams where they are listed as staff.

Coaches message the team, schedule events and lineups, and review stats, insights, and game film for practice planning and player development. Families and fans follow along with real-time live streaming in HD, GameStream animations, live game alerts, and play-by-plays. Confirmed family members and players can broadcast games live in all sports by default. Watching live streams of sports such as basketball, volleyball, and soccer is free without limit.

The company was founded in 2009, is headquartered in New York City, and says it covers more than nine million games annually across baseball, softball, basketball, volleyball, soccer, football, lacrosse, hockey, and more. It also puts its reach at close to 10 million games and more than a million teams a year. GameChanger is owned and operated by DICK'S Sporting Goods, described as one of the largest sporting goods retailers in the United States.

quote.text: Youth sports change lives on and off the field.
